definitions.contentMs: page performance.now() at the first visible match of the content selector (MutationObserver); 0 = navigation start
definitions.rows: rendered rows of the main list (rows selector) at the end of the settle window
definitions.blocked: a role=alert with "No tienes acceso" is shown at the end of the settle window (student detail: the 403 error state instead of the student); blockedRuns counts them
definitions.apiDepth: sequential waves among API requests until the content: wave = 1 + highest wave of the API requests that had finished before it started
definitions.depthWithChunks: same rule over document + JS chunks + API requests served from the network (cache hits excluded) until the content; an upper bound
definitions.warm: second full visit (page.goto) of the same URL in the same browser context: HTTP cache warm, SWR memory cache empty
definitions.session: each round writes the context storage state back to the role file, so cold visits start with a fresh access token (the warm-up round absorbs the first refresh)
definitions.firstLoad: scripts/perf/bundle-sizes.mjs over .next/build-manifest.json: shared (_app + main + polyfills) + route files, gzip level default
